A '''rune sword''' is a medium-level [[sword]] made out of [[Rune equipment|rune]]. Like all [[rune weapons]], it requires 40 [[Attack]] to wield.

A rune sword can be created at level 89 [[Smithing]] using 1 [[rune bar]], giving the player 75 Smithing [[experience]].

Rune swords are ideal for non-member [[Ironman Mode|Ironmen]] as the only way to obtain a [[rune scimitar]] in a [[free-to-play]] world is to create it from scratch, requiring 90 Smithing (89 with a [[Dwarven stout]]), whereas a rune sword can be purchased from [[Scavvo's Rune Store]] in the [[Champions' Guild]] for a price of {{Coins|20800}} after obtaining 32 [[quest points]].
